'''Z0-B5''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that was used as a messenger by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Jiak]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Z0-B5 appears as the Imperial Flashpoint Courier for the Flashpoint "Directive 7" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
